_featured_note: Projects shown in the 'Selected work' section, in this order. Their description and topics are read straight from GitHub, so a repository with no description on GitHub is skipped rather than published with placeholder text. Adding more is the single best improvement you can make to this page: write a description and add topics on GitHub, then list the repository here.
_architecture_note: Per-project architecture rows for the project drawings. Only state a layer you can actually back up; every value here is taken from that repository's own GitHub description or topics, and layers that its metadata does not mention are left out rather than guessed. Add rows as you confirm them. Keys are free text, so 'Queue', 'Cache', or 'Auth' work as well as the ones used here.
_timeline_note: Professional roles, newest first, rendered as a revision history. Left empty deliberately: nothing here is invented, and this file has no record of your employment. Fill it in and the section appears above the derived activity log. Format: {"rev": "04", "period": "2024-", "title": "Your role", "detail": "One line on the systems you worked on"}
_extra_note: Repositories outside your own account, such as organisation ones, given as owner/name. FADHATECHNOLOGY/comas used to be listed here but is no longer publicly available, so it was removed.
_exclude_note: Repositories left off the site, each with the reason. This is a starting point, not a verdict: add or remove entries freely. Anything excluded here is still public on GitHub, it is just not featured on the portfolio. To hide a repository from your GitHub profile as well, archive it.
